$doc: docs/DESIGN_Scenario_Regression.md §3 — CE-9005 (docs/designs/vehicle-tactics/DESIGN_Road_Convoy.md §5 S-6): mode 2, an off-road start joins the road net, drives its lane, leaves it to an off-road target, unsplit. The lane rows judge EVERY sample between x 350 and x 450 (a lane band, y 541.8 ± 3.5), not one point — the cluster tier samples about once a second (a 3 m circle was stepped over). No golden yet. The band is x 350–450: at x 300 the road graph kinks 12 m to the SUMO junction's centre (CE-9011, the importer) and every vehicle on it swerves there. The never-splits rows read POSITIONS (far, CE-9009), so they judge the same in both tiers (the trail lives only on the kinematic owner).
